title: Mathematics — generative structures, transformations, invariants, limits and inference
status: Five canonical mathematical families composed on reading; 14 books, 39 studies and 46 curiosity entrances
question: What small set of mathematical constructions, structures, transformations and tests generates broad families of questions, theorems and real applications?
purpose: Navigate from authentic naive questions or ambitious mathematical/engineering goals through a composable mathematical capability landscape to source-backed distinctions and reusable books.

nodes.question: What makes mathematics generative rather than a collection of formulas?
nodes.why: An analogy is useful only when operations, domains, outputs and invariants are specified.
nodes.mechanism_explanation: Give objects structure, use structure-preserving transformations, derive invariants, use limits or counts to investigate, and prove conclusions under precise hypotheses. Distinct mathematical fields are overlapping toolkits, not book-bound taxonomies.

cross_book_factors.function: Give one carrier set different laws and see what becomes possible
cross_book_factors.operator_chain: Halmos set operations → Artin/Halmos algebraic structures → Munkres topology → Royden measurable spaces
cross_book_factors.critical_contract: Carrier, added structure, preserving map, invariant
cross_book_factors.discriminator: Use one set with two topologies and measure how continuity changes

cross_book_factors.function: Collapse equivalent representations while preserving laws
cross_book_factors.operator_chain: Halmos equivalence classes → Artin normal quotient and ring quotient → Munkres quotient topology
cross_book_factors.critical_contract: Compatibility of identification with the operation or topology
cross_book_factors.discriminator: Attempt quotient group multiplication using a nonnormal subgroup

cross_book_factors.function: Use symmetry to avoid double-counting identical configurations
cross_book_factors.operator_chain: Artin group actions → Stanley labeled/unlabeled counting → Diestel graph symmetries
cross_book_factors.critical_contract: Allowed symmetry group, orbit, stabilizer and labeling
cross_book_factors.discriminator: Count bead necklaces under rotation and then reflection

cross_book_factors.function: Invert aggregate counts on structured hierarchies
cross_book_factors.operator_chain: Stanley posets/§3.7 Möbius inversion → Hardy divisor sums and arithmetic functions
cross_book_factors.critical_contract: Locally finite poset and appropriate incidence convolution
cross_book_factors.discriminator: Recover primitive periodic strings from total periodic counts

cross_book_factors.function: Turn local rules into global sequence counts
cross_book_factors.operator_chain: Diestel graph walks → Stanley §4.7 finite-state transfer matrix → Feller generating functions
cross_book_factors.discriminator: Count forbidden-substring words by enumeration and matrix powers

cross_book_factors.function: Recognize where finite matrix decomposition stops working
cross_book_factors.operator_chain: Halmos eigen/spectral modes → Artin Jordan form → Kreyszig/Royden operator domains and spectra
cross_book_factors.discriminator: Compare defective Jordan matrix to differentiation in an Lp domain

cross_book_factors.function: Know exactly when limits commute with operations
cross_book_factors.operator_chain: Rudin Ch 7 → Royden Lebesgue convergence → Kreyszig completeness
cross_book_factors.critical_contract: Uniformity, monotonicity, domination and closed limits
cross_book_factors.discriminator: Exhibit pointwise-zero spike with nonzero integral

cross_book_factors.function: Connect local geometric invariants with global consequences
cross_book_factors.operator_chain: Munkres loops/coverings → do Carmo Gauss–Bonnet/geodesics → Ahlfors conformal maps
cross_book_factors.critical_contract: Topology, orientation, boundary, analyticity and smoothness
cross_book_factors.discriminator: Compare total curvature and loops on a sphere and torus

cross_book_factors.function: Differentiate computable, nonconstructive and impossible solutions
cross_book_factors.operator_chain: Halmos choice/Zorn → Kreyszig Hahn–Banach and contractions → Artin algebraic impossibility
cross_book_factors.critical_contract: Choice axioms, contraction constants, field degrees
cross_book_factors.discriminator: Identify which proof actually yields an algorithm

cross_book_factors.function: Build inference from probabilistic models without confusing the two
cross_book_factors.operator_chain: Royden normalized measure → Feller random processes → Casella/Berger likelihood, sufficiency and tests
cross_book_factors.critical_contract: Sample law, independence, risk, power and interval coverage
cross_book_factors.discriminator: Simulate dependent samples and check nominal false-positive rates

cross_book_factors.function: Transport integer questions into algebraic and analytic settings
cross_book_factors.operator_chain: Hardy congruences/arithmetical functions → Artin ideals/Galois → Ahlfors analytic techniques
cross_book_factors.critical_contract: Ring, prime notion, field extension and convergence domain
cross_book_factors.discriminator: Contrast modular obstruction and ideal-factorization failure

cross_book_factors.function: Replace exhaustive path search with structural obstructions
cross_book_factors.operator_chain: Diestel matching, flow, cuts and minors → Stanley enumerative alternatives
cross_book_factors.critical_contract: Edge/vertex capacity, disjointness and permissible minor operations
cross_book_factors.discriminator: Construct many routes through a single small cut
